record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) In the case of officers of or above the rank of __________ the proceedings shall be held by gazetted officer. (b) Every person preferring an appeal shall do so separately and in his __________. (c) No order of punishment passed in a proceeding may be modified or cancelled without the sanction of the ____________ authority. (d) No_________ penalty shall generally be imposed upon Police Officer without informing him of the ground on which it is proposed to take action and without sufficient opportunity to be heard. (e) Period on limitation for preferring appeal to the appellate authority is ________________. (f) _________________ is the disciplinary authority to impose a penalty of removal from service upon the Inspector of Police. (g) In Disciplinary Proceedings the __________ is of the greatest importance and its error could vitiate the whole enquiry. (h) There is no appeal in case of __________. (i) Major penalty can be imposed upon the police officers straight away based on _____________ order in a criminal court. (j) No Pleader or Counsel shall be ___________ to appear in any disciplinary proceeding or appeal.
